**Scope(s):** THEORY-LEVEL · **Row count:** 1 · **Lifecycle (candidate):** DORMANT · **Layer (provisional):** LAYER-UNRESOLVED

## Sources (how this label entered the ledger)
- **OBJECT-INDEX** batch `B0033`, scope `THEORY-LEVEL`: Proposes the central mathematical object K=(X,T,C,P,A,G,R) (epistemic propositions/states, temporal structure, context, provenance/evidence, actors/authority, governance state, typed relationships) as the top-level formalization of KnowledgeOS, built explicitly to preserve rather than collapse the established chain Observation!=Evidence!=Claim!=Inference!=Determination!=Decision, using distribution theory + measure theory + temporal logic + graph theory + Bayesian inference + information theory + state-transition systems. Reformalizes a proposition as context-and-time-qualified P=(p,c,t,s) (proposition, bounded context, time, semantic scope) rather than a bare boolean. Formalizes the RealityTime/KnowledgeTime distinction from Step 185 mathematically: R(p,t_r) (reality state at reality time) generally != K(p,t_k) (organization's epistemic state at knowledge time), yielding a two-dimensional epistemic space E subseteq T_R x T_K x P, 'much stronger than ordinary version control.'
